treaty_name: Convention between Hungary and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2015, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: Article 28 ... 2. This Convention shall enter into force on the 30th day following the date of receipt of the latter of the notifications referred to in paragraph 1 and its provisions shall have effect in both Contracting States: (a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force (LU list: 'Mémorial A n° 270 de 2016, page 4838 à partir du 01/01/2018')
source_title: LU–HU Convention signed 10 March 2015 – English signed text (Luxembourg ACD); MLI synthesised text EN (20/01/2022)

rates.quote: (a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership that is not liable to tax), which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends,
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Convention: ... Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted ... (WHT: events on or after 1 January 2022 in both States)

notes: 2015 Convention replaced the 1990 LU–HU Convention (applied until 31/12/2017). Signed English text is a scan with OCR layer (minor OCR noise corrected in quotes). EIF date from treaty-map dataset; effect 1.1.2018 consistent with LU list.
